# Lamentations 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** How the Lord in His anger has set the daughter of Zion under a cloud! He has cast down from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel; He has not remembered His footstool in the day of His anger.

**2** The Lord has swallowed up without mercy all the habitations of Jacob; in His wrath He has broken down the strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He has brought down to the ground in dishonor the kingdom and its rulers.

**3** He has cut down in fierce anger all the might of Israel; He has withdrawn from them His right hand in the face of the enemy; He has burned through Jacob like a flaming fire, consuming all around.

**4** He has bent His bow like an enemy, with His right hand set like a foe; and He has killed all who were delightful in our eyes in the tent of the daughter of Zion; He has poured out His fury like fire.

**5** The Lord has become like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel; He has swallowed up all its palaces; He has laid in ruins its strongholds, and He has multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

**6** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**7** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**8** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**9** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**10** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**11** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**12** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**13** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**14** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**15** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**16** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**17** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**18** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**19** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**20** The Lord in His wrath brought down the walls of Zion; her gates have sunk into the ground.

**21** In the dust of the streets lie the young and the old; my young women and my young men have fallen by the sword; You have killed them in the day of Your anger, slaughtering without pity.

**22** You summoned as if to a festival day my terrors on every side, and on the day of the anger of the LORD no one escaped or survived; those whom I held and raised, my enemy destroyed.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

- **2:1-5**: Five verses, each beginning with God as subject of violent verbs: covered, swallowed, cut down, bent, become an enemy. The literary effect is relentless.

- **2:4**: God as enemy is the book's most theologically daring claim. The covenant protector has become the covenant enforcer through destruction.

- **2:22**: The 'day of the LORD' tradition (cf. Amos 5:18-20) reaches its darkest expression here. The day of divine intervention becomes the day of divine annihilation.

— LOGOS
